hook: Small (小) grain (麦, wheat or barley): the little grains that make bread, wheat.
House (屋) + root (根): the roof is like a root for the house, but on top.
我 means I or self; 々 repeats it: many selves together means we.
Put together (組) and woven (織): people woven into one group, an organization.
Body (体) + heavy (重): how heavy your body is, your weight.
対 means opposite or facing: to face or stand against someone.
From 包む (to wrap): something wrapped up, a package.
From 勤める (to work for a company): your job, your employment.
Hold out (提) and put out (出): hand in your homework, a submission.
Electric (電) + small thing (子): a tiny electric particle, an electron.
Climb (登) a mountain (山): mountain climbing.
突 means thrust or sudden, 然 means "in that way": suddenly, out of nowhere.
何 (what) + とか: "somehow or other", you manage in some way.
激 means fierce, like crashing water (氵): violent, intense.
Not (非) usual (常): not normal at all, so an emergency or extraordinary.
Day (日) + attach (付): the day you attach to a letter, the date.
Not (不) right (正): unfair, unjust.
再 means again, like in 再来週 (the week after next): once more, again.
Things (物) + price (価): the prices of things.
Not (不) full (満): not satisfied, so you complain.
震 has rain (雨) on top, like a storm shaking the ground: to shake or shiver.
Real (本) thing (物): the genuine article, not a fake.
学 is study, as in 学校 (school): to learn.
当 means right or proper, 然 means "so": rightly so, of course.
税 has grain (禾) on the left: in old times, tax was paid in rice.
Tree (木) on the left: a flat piece of wood, a board.
額 has head (頁) on the right: a frame hangs on a wall like a big forehead; also an amount of money.
Sounds like English "can": a can or tin.
逆 has the moving part (辶): going the wrong way, the reverse.
額 has head (頁) on the right: the top front of your head, your forehead.
Earth (土) on the left: castles had big earth walls, a castle.
刀 looks like a curved blade: a sword (katana).
Person (亻) on the left: a hurt on a person, a wound.
Body part (月) + vital (要): the vital middle part of your body, your waist and hips.
A net (罒) over wrong (非): wrong acts caught in the net of the law, a crime.
Metal (金) + ten (十): a thin metal needle.
騒 has horse (馬): noisy horses running wild, an uproar.
Four (四) seasons (季): spring, summer, autumn and winter.
Time (時) + period (期): a time or season.
示 is in 表示 (display): to show or point out.
賞 has shell (貝, old money) at the bottom: a prize, often with money.
Illness (症, with the sickness part 疒) + state (状): the state of your sickness, symptoms.
Trade (商) person (人): a merchant.
Few (少) years (年): a young boy.
Advance (進) in learning (学): go on to a higher school.
Real (真) sword (剣): fighting with a real sword makes you serious.
New (新) + fresh (鮮, with fish 魚): fresh like a fish just caught.
Believe (信) + use (用): you trust someone enough to rely on them, confidence.
Push (推) forward + offer (薦): push someone forward as a good choice, recommend.
Both kanji have eye (目): eyes closed, sleep.
少し (a little) + も: not even a little, not one bit.
Control (制) + limit (限): a restriction.
Made (製) goods (品): manufactured products.
Pile up (積) to the extreme (極) + "like" (的): very active and positive.
From 空く (to become empty): an empty space or opening.
跡 has foot (足) on the left: footprints, a trace left behind.
Medicine (医) + master (師): a doctor.
Place (位) + put (置): where something is put, its position.
City (市) + place (場): the place in town where you buy food, a market.
One (一) kind (種): a kind or sort.
One (一) + sort (般), all as one: general, ordinary.
Pull (引) back (退): retire from work or sport.
失 means lose, as in 失礼: to lose.
King (王) + polite 様: the king.
Picture (画) + expert (家): a painter.
Self (我) + pride (慢): keep your pride and self quiet, be patient.
Watch (観) + guest (客): guests who watch, the audience.
Joy (歓) + meet (迎): meet someone with joy, welcome.
Watch over (監) + command (督): the person who watches and leads, the director.
嫌 means dislike: your 機嫌 shows if you like or dislike things now, your mood.
Base (基) + origin (本): the basics.
Together (共) + pass through (通): something that runs through all, in common.
Together (共) + same (同): working together, cooperation.
Allow (許) + OK (可): permission.
By chance (偶) + "so" (然): it just happened so, by chance.
Tool (具) + body (体): something with a real body you can touch, concrete.
暮 is sunset (日 in the grass): day after day until sunset, you live.
Pass through (経) + run (営): run a business, management.
Measure (計) + count (算): calculation.
Art skill (芸) + technique (術): the fine arts.
Drama (劇) + place (場): a theater.
Decide (決) + fix (定): a final decision.
Tie up (結) the argument (論): the conclusion.
Limit (限) + boundary (界): the limit.
See (見) + hit (当): see where it will hit, a guess.
Light (光) + view (景): a scene.
After (後) + fellows (輩): people who came after you, juniors.
Wait (候) + fill in (補): someone waiting to fill a place, a candidate.
Language (語) + study (学): language study.
Most (最) high (高): the highest, the best.
Talent (才) + ability (能): talent.
幸 means happiness, as in 幸せ: luckily, fortunately.
盛 means heap up: a heaped plate is a serving; life heaped up high is its peak (さかり).
避 has the moving part (辶): move away to avoid something.
Tree (木) on the left: first a wooden tag, now a paper note (bill).
認 has words (言): say yes, admit or recognize.
See (見) a sick friend and dance (舞) around them with kindness: a get-well visit.
向 means facing, as in 向こう: to turn something toward.
Eye (目) + up (上): someone you look up to, your senior.
From 戻る (to go back): to put back.
求 means seek, as in 要求 (demand): to ask for or look for.
Only (唯) one (一): the only one.
Have (有) effect (効): valid, it works.
許 has words (言): say "yes, you may", to allow or forgive.
Flow (流) + go (行): what flows through the town, a trend.
列 is in 行列 (a line of people): a line or row.
Argument (論) + writing (文): a thesis or paper.
Public (公) + perform (演): a public performance.
Increase (増) + add (加): an increase.
Fast (速) + degree (度): how fast, the speed.
Exist (存) + be there (在): existence.
Body (体) + warm (温): body temperature.
玉 is a jewel (王 with a dot): a ball or round thing.
Know (知) + recognize (識): knowledge.
Extent (程) + degree (度): level, degree.
Hand (手) + time (間): hand work and time, effort.
Same (同) time (時): at the same time.
Read (読) books (書): reading.
Years (年, とし) and months (月, つき): a long time passing.
Way (途) + edge (端): at the edge of an action, just as it happens.
Earth (土) + ground (地): land.
Inside (中) + body (身): what is inside, the contents.
Put in (納) + gain (得): take it in and get it, understanding.
Metal (金) on the left: a metal pot.
Years (年, ねん) and months (月, げつ) in on readings: a long period of time.
Through (中) the year (年): all year round, always.
放 means release, as in 放送 (broadcast): let go, set free.
羽 looks like two feathers side by side: a wing.
Sure (必) death (死): fight as if facing certain death, desperate.
One person (一人), one person (一人): each person, one by one.
Criticize (批) + judge (判): criticism.
Spend (費) + use (用): cost.
Divide (分) + split (析): break into parts, analysis.
別 means separate or other: "nothing in particular".
減 has water (氵): water level going down, to reduce.
Direction (方) + facing (向): direction.
Keep (保) + exist (存): keep something so it lasts, save.
Self (自) + self (己): oneself.
True (真) + reason (理): the truth.
Protect (保) + barrier (障): a wall of protection, a guarantee or security.
Words (言) + temple (寺): words chanted like at a temple, a poem.
劇 has knife (刂): strong action on stage, a drama or play.
恋 has heart (心) at the bottom: love.
陸 has hill (阝 on the left): land, not sea.
異 means different, as in 異なる: a difference.
策 is in 対策 (countermeasure): a plan or policy.
象 was a picture of an elephant with its trunk on top: elephant.
Cart (車) + dry (干): the roof edge that keeps carts dry, the eaves.
Stand (立) on the left: stand at the very edge, the end or edge.
Bamboo (竹) + flesh (月) + power (力): strong lines in your body, muscle.
Water (氵) + dry (干): water that dries on your skin, sweat.
Water (氵) on the left: a liquid, oil.
馬 is a picture of a horse with four legs: horse.
Water (氵) + middle (中): the middle of the water, the open sea.
Rain (雨) over a field (田): what crashes over the fields in a storm, thunder.
Thread (糸) on the left: steps in a row like on a thread, a class or grade.
券 has knife (刀) at the bottom: a ticket you cut or tear.
Metal (金) on the left, like a metal hook: fishing.
Water (氵) + skin (皮): the skin of the water, a wave.
Fire (火) inside: what is left after a fire, ash.
Grain (禾) + few (少): a tiny bit of time, a second.
票 is in 投票 (voting): a ballot, label or slip.
Four (四) corners (角): a square.
Stab (刺) + violent (激): a sharp poke, a stimulus.
Poem (詩) person (人): a poet.
Think (思) + idea (想): a way of thinking, thought.
Real (実) + appear (現): make it appear for real, realization.
Lose (失) hope (望): disappointment.
Real (実) power (力): your true ability.
Grass (芝) + sit (居): people once sat on the grass to watch plays.
Grass (芝) grows (生): a lawn.
Self (自) + pride (慢): boasting about yourself.
Around (周) + enclose (囲): what is all around you, surroundings.
Gather (収) + harvest (穫, with grain 禾): harvest.
Gather (収) + come in (入): money that comes in, income.
Hand (手) + step (段): the steps you take, a means.
Put out (出) + printing block (版): publication.
Kind (種) + type (類): variety, kind.
Ride (乗) + guest (客): a passenger.
Use up (消) + spend (費): consumption.
Put out (消) fires + defend (防): fire fighting.
Food (食) + materials (料): food supplies.
Help (助) + hand (手): a helping hand, an assistant.
Careful (慎) + heavy (重): careful and serious.
Advance (進) step (歩): progress.
Mind (心) + logic (理): how the mind works, mentality.
Age (世) + record (紀): a recorded age of 100 years, a century.
Spirit (精) + god (神): your mind or spirit.
Green (青, young) + years (年): a young man.
Arrange (整) + order (理): sorting things out.
Match (合) + picture (図): a sign everyone agrees on, a signal.
明 is bright (sun 日 + moon 月): the sky gets bright, dawn.
預 is in 預金 (savings): leave something with someone, deposit.
辺 means area or side, as in この辺: the area nearby.
誤 has words (言): wrong words, an error.
Entrust (委) + member (員): a committee member.
Living (生き) thing (物): a creature.
Mind (意) + aim (志): your will.
Receive (受け) + take (取る): to receive.
Have (有) or not have (無): yes or no, presence or absence.
